name: DataFeedWatch Connector for WooCommerce
author: dfwbycart

sections.description:
DataFeedWatch Connector for WooCommerce helps to seamlessly integrate your WooCommerce store with DataFeedWatch to get information about products.

DataFeedWatch makes it easy to create product feeds for Google Shopping, Facebook Ads, Meta, Bing Ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and 2,000+ channels & marketplaces. Map each channel’s requirements with our pre-loaded product feed templates—no developers or coding needed! Fill in datafeed gaps. Find & fix feed errors. And improve sales performance across all your channels & marketplaces.

KEY FEATURES

Create powerful product feeds and increase sales in 3 simple steps
One-click integration with Google Shopping, Facebook Ads, Meta, Bing Ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and 2000+ channels & marketplaces.

Map Your Product Feeds At Scale Fast
Use our product mapping templates to speed up your work. All channel requirements are pre-loaded so your data feeds are automatically generated in the right format.

Catch Product Errors Automatically Before Pushing To Channels
Find product errors before uploading your products to Google Merchant Center or other Ad Manager platforms. See a detailed list of any errors and the exact steps to fix them. Check the health of your feed with our Feed Quality Score.

Get Complete Control Over Every Attribute In Your Product Feed
Optimize your product titles without touching your backend. Run A/B tests and capitalize on what’s working. Add missing data at scale. And create complex conditional rules for shopping feeds.

Manage & Sync Inventory Levels Across All Channels
No longer waste your advertising budget on products that aren’t in stock. Simply use the availability attribute to keep track of inventory levels across all channels.

Create Text Ads Automatically For Every Product In Your Feed
Create Text Ads without writing a single word and catch bottom-of-the funnel customers with the keywords they’re searching. Ads and keywords are updated every time you add or remove a product.

Powerful optimization platform

  • Submit all variants – you can merge and unmerge your feed based on the channel requirements.
  • Create, edit and map your product feeds by easily setting up complex rules.
  • Edit fields like Description, Title, URL and more.
  • Include or exclude products with just a few clicks (like for seasonal or out of stock items).
  • Use look-up tables for missing information in the source feed. Exclude unprofitable products and make changes to your product titles.
  • Assign Google categories to your products painlessly.
  • Use powerful optimization tools like look-up tables and regular expressions.

THIRD-PARTY SERVICE INTEGRATION

DataFeedWatch Connector for WooCommerce helps to seamlessly integrate your WooCommerce store with DataFeedWatch and deliver products information to your DataFeedWatch account.
To make the connection work the plugin is using api2cart service as a provider.

After successful plugin installation and shop configuration in DataFeedWatch, all the requests to fetch products information from your website will be done using api2cart service and delivered to your DataFeedWatch account.

The plugin itself can make requests to http://app.api2cart.com/ servers to verify the signature to make sure the connection works correctly.

We care about you data. Feel free to check our terms of use an privacy policies.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin
  2. Activate
  3. Proceed to Admin -> Plugins, find and choose “DataFeedWatch Connector for WooCommerce”.
  4. Click the Connect button to establish the connection.
  5. Click “Go To DataFeedWatch” button to login/register in DataFeedWatch.
  6. Follow the guidelines how to connect your WooCommerce store.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create an account on DataFeedWatch?

Having the plugin installed is not enough. The plugin is only a connector which allows to seamlessly integrate your WooCommerce store with DataFeedWatch. To optimize and automate your product feeds you need to have DataFeedWatch account.

Is There a Trial Version of DataFeedWatch that I can use?

Yes there is! Every new client can benefit from Free Trial period of 15 days.

Can I cancel at any time?

Of course! You can cancel your subscription at any time without any additional cost.

Can you set up and optimize the feed for me?

Yes, we’re happy to! Just reach out to our Support Team and they will take care of the rest.
sections.changelog:
3.0.8

  • Fixed product.variant.update method. Updated bridge to 188 version.

3.0.9

  • Updated bridge to 190 version. Fixed cart.meta_data.set method.

3.0.10

  • Updated bridge to 192 version. Added compatibility with WooCommerce 10+ version.

3.0.11

  • Updated bridge to 198 version. Added Polylang multilingual plugin support.

3.0.12

  • Updated bridge to 203 version. Added detailed bridge trace output for adapter errors and fixed SKU update.

3.1.0

  • Updated bridge to 205 version. Added native WooCommerce 10.7+ order fulfillment support (order.shipment.list/add/add.batch/update/delete/tracking.add via the new wc_order_fulfillments table).

3.1.1

  • Public key refreshed.

3.1.2

  • Updated bridge to 209 version. Fixed a bug where duplicate products could potentially be created when executing the product.add method.

3.2.0

  • Fixed an issue with closing the global database connection, which caused WooCommerce Action Scheduler PHP Fatal errors.

3.2.1

  • Updated bridge to 211 version. Security fix: the bridge endpoint now resolves and authorizes the action from the signed request body only, and file saving is restricted to the uploads directory with a stricter file name check.
